## Goal
Clearly state what should exist when this issue is done.

## Context
Why this change is needed. Link related code or prior issues.

## Requirements
- [ ] Must do X
- [ ] Must not break Y
- [ ] Must handle edge case Z

## Non-Goals
Explicitly list what should NOT be changed.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Feature works in scenario A
- [ ] No changes outside scope
